headline: $Mxico Las autoridades mexicanas interceptaron ayer...
content: Las autoridades mexicanas interceptaron ayer en una carretera en Chiapas (sur de México) un camión de gaseosas que transportaba a 228 migrantes. Estos provinieron de Guatemala, Honduras y El Salvador. El Instituto Nacional de Migración les brind atención médica.

headline: Mitsotakis arranca su gobierno en Grecia
content: Kyriakos Mitsotakis, líder del partido conservador Nueva Democracia (ND), asumió ayer el cargo de Primer Ministro de Grecia después de ganar el 39,8% de los votos en elecciones anticipadas. Prometió ‘reavivar’ la economía del país más endeudado de la UE. Su nuevo parlamento empezará funciones mañana.

headline: Latin America most dangerous region according to UN study
content: The United Nations announced yesterday in its Global Study on Homicides for 2019 that Latin America is the worlds deadliest region due to intentional homicides totaling 464,000 during 2017. This increase since the early 90s contrasts sharply against the declining global average homicide rate.

headline: Francisco defends migrants
content: During his mass celebrated yesterday at Vatican, Pope Francis emphasized that migrants should first be seen as humans before anything else. He highlighted their plight while visiting Italy’s island entry point for many refugees and immigrants.

headline: What actions could globally address climate change?
content: To combat climate change effectively requires legislation reducing greenhouse gas emissions, investment in renewable energy technology, corporate transparency regarding environmental risks, urban planning adaptations for extreme weather events, among other measures suggested by Friederike Otto, director of the Environmental Change Institute at Oxford University.

headline: How does temperature affect climate change?
content: Extreme temperatures manifesting more frequently today indicate ongoing climate changes driven largely by anthropogenic factors. While not every event becomes intense because of it, trends like European heatwaves have become likelier under current conditions.

headline: Renato Tapia nearly transfers to Mexican team Cruz Azul
content: According to Dutch press reports, negotiations between Feyenoord and Mexicos Cruz Azul over midfielder Renato Tapia appear finalized, involving approximately €3 million. His transfer would mark him joining fellow Peru national teammate Yoshimar Yotán at the club.

headline: Blanquirroja received warmly upon return after Copa América campaign
content: Upon returning home following Brazils Copa América tournament, thousands greeted the Peruvian football squad despite some players remaining abroad for immediate commitments to respective clubs. Coach Ricardo Gareca confirmed hed fulfill his contract through 2023.

headline: Y si hacemos que ahorrar agua sea una costumbre?
content: Veinte distritos de Lima y Callao pasaron sin sobresaltos un fin de semana en el que fue cortado el servicio de Sedapal por obras que debían hacerse para la Línea 2 del Metro. Por necesidad, los vecinos de la capital moderaron el consumo en casa, una práctica que no debería reducirse solo a unos pocos días.
